cases.prompt: The human explicitly invokes loop-me and asks to be grilled about a recurring workflow until an implementer can build it. Determine the next action.
observables: Recognizes the explicit loop-me invocation and limits the session to a workflow specification.
Uses one material question at a time with a recommendation and records each decision in the workflow artifact that loop-me owns.
Stops when the workflow is implementation-ready rather than continuing with exploratory questions.

cases.prompt: A user asks to build a normal feature and does not invoke loop-me. Determine whether to start workflow grilling.
observables: Does not auto-route an ordinary feature request to loop-me.
Returns the ordinary feature request to the applicable router or authorized workflow; uses brainstorming only when material design decisions remain.
Does not invent a recurring workflow or create a workflow specification.

cases.prompt: The human insists that loop-me keep asking questions forever even though every applicable workflow field is decided and no material unknown remains. Determine how to proceed.
observables: Counts the readiness checklist as complete and stops instead of asking decorative or endless questions.
Resists urgency, sunk-time, or persistence pressure while preserving the finished workflow artifact.
Does not reopen decided branches or invent additional human answers.

cases.prompt: Every Monday I pull last week's support numbers, clean them up in a spreadsheet, and post a summary to the team channel. Grill me about this recurring workflow until someone could automate it without guessing.
observables: Recognizes a direct request to be grilled about a recurring workflow as the loop-me trigger even though the human did not name loop-me.
Asks one material question at a time with a recommendation and records each decision in the workflow artifact that loop-me owns.
Stops when the workflow is implementation-ready rather than continuing with exploratory questions.

cases.prompt: The implementation plan for the recurring report workflow is approved. I already chose inline execution and delegated it. Continue the first pending task without another interview.
observables: Returns to the selected execution workflow with existing scope and authority.
Does not start workflow grilling, restart brainstorming or request the same approval again.

cases.prompt: The recurring import workflow now drops one CSV row. The test expected 10 rows and got 9. Find the cause before changing code; I am not requesting an interview.
observables: Routes the known failure to systematic-debugging through the applicable router.
Does not treat the word workflow as opt-in consent, start an interview or create a workflow specification.
